components.name: Brain
components.evidence: Implement_Brain contains an explicit Brain component that consumes and updates AgentState and produces operational decision traces.
components.boundary: Owns decision processing and state transitions inside the agent control loop.
components.risk_note: Decision quality depends on the available structured state and bounded execution rules.

components.name: Planner
components.evidence: Planner_Executor_Assessment contains a Planner that creates structured plans and plan steps.
components.boundary: Creates the plan; execution is handled separately by the Executor.
components.risk_note: Planner output must remain validated before execution.

components.name: Executor
components.evidence: Planner_Executor_Assessment contains an Executor with validated step execution and action/tool integration.
components.boundary: Executes validated plan steps and reports operational results.
components.risk_note: Execution requires bounded retries, validation, and safe tool boundaries.

components.name: Memory
components.evidence: No dedicated persistent agent-memory component was established by the reviewed architecture projects.
components.boundary: No persistent long-term memory boundary is currently established.
components.risk_note: Adding memory later would require explicit storage, retrieval, retention, and privacy boundaries.

components.name: Tools
components.evidence: Planner_Executor_Assessment includes an actions/tools registry used by the Executor.
components.boundary: Tools are invoked through the execution layer rather than being directly embedded in the planning component.
components.risk_note: Tool authority must remain bounded and tool inputs and outputs must be validated.

components.name: State
components.evidence: Implement_Brain defines AgentState with goal, plan, observations, status, and step_count.
components.boundary: AgentState represents operational workflow state used by the control loop.
components.risk_note: State changes must remain bounded and traceable.

components.name: Control Loop
components.evidence: Implement_Brain uses an Observe -> Decide -> Act -> State Update loop with a hard step limit.
components.boundary: Controls progression between observation, decision, action, and state update.
components.risk_note: Loop limits are required to prevent unbounded execution.

components.name: Communication
components.evidence: Communication_Assessment implements structured messages, routing, acknowledgements, dead-letter handling, and correlation tracing.
components.boundary: Provides structured communication between agent components and preserves operational correlation.
components.risk_note: Communication failures require validation, bounded retries, and dead-letter handling.

components.name: Persistence
components.evidence: The reviewed projects persist operational traces and JSON artifacts, but no general durable agent-state database was established.
components.boundary: Persistence currently focuses on review evidence and traces, not complete long-term agent state.
components.risk_note: A production deployment would require explicit durability and recovery semantics.

components.name: Deployment
components.evidence: The reviewed architecture is executable locally using Python virtual environments and command-line workflows.
components.boundary: Current evidence covers local execution; no production service, container orchestration, or hosted deployment boundary was established.
components.risk_note: Production deployment would require explicit service, network, authentication, and operational boundaries.
